subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway/plugin control API after the session-targeting blocker is fixed?
rationale: This PR creates a new authenticated HTTP/Gateway-facing plugin API with admin rotate semantics, so the final API surface and ownership boundary need maintainer intent beyond the mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve after scoping fix
options.body: Keep the generic API direction, but require canonical session targeting, regression tests, and conflict refresh before merge.

options.title: Narrow to read-only first
options.body: Ship capabilities/status/doctor only and defer rotate until the mutation/session contract is clearer.

options.title: Defer to plugin-owned surfaces
options.body: Close or pause the core API and ask downstream control planes to use plugin/private surfaces until a broader design is accepted.

recommendation.title: Approve after scoping fix
recommendation.body: Keep the generic API direction, but require canonical session targeting, regression tests, and conflict refresh before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the clearest current-main owner for the session canonicalization helpers this API must reuse.
